ZAF.note: The document states nothing on digital-skills training for civil servants in South Africa.
The communique only commits to expanding rural coverage, a pledge; no programme, sites or rural-urban use figures are stated for South Africa.
The minister speaks of digital literacy in general terms; no programme or measured share is stated.
The communique mentions national cloud in general terms only; no state-data rule, hosting or contract terms are stated.
The only internet usage figures (600 million users, 43 per cent) are for Africa as a whole, not South Africa.
No data centre in South Africa is named.

facts.fact: South Africa's communications minister, with the ministers of Kenya and Uganda and the African Telecommunications Union secretary general, signed a joint communique at the ATU, DCDT and Huawei ministerial forum in Cape Town committing to national cloud, solar micro-grids and rural coverage, as reported by Gadget.

ZAF.note: No school internet figure or curriculum statement for South Africa is given.
